checkpoints.quote: BANKUI-2F0 (SecurityError: Cross-origin frame blocked) - Events: 4,812 | Users: 1 - Cause: Chrome extension inject.js trying to access a cross-origin frame. - Note: All events from same browser session — likely extension behavior, not app logic. - Implication: Not a bug in bank-ui — extension or browser policy issue.
checkpoints.reason: The analysis correctly identifies 4,812 events, 1 user, chrome-extension origin, no app breadcrumbs, and concludes it is not an app defect that should be filtered.
